candidate: deterministic claim_id plus immutable idempotent effect identity and immutable successor receipt, all role-local and replayable after restart

state_model.identity: claim_id=C; effect path and successor path are deterministic functions of C; effect record binds C plus effect_payload_hash H

states.Q0: claim absent; effect absent; successor absent
states.Q1: claim committed; effect absent; successor absent
states.Q2: claim committed; effect committed with matching C,H; successor absent
states.Q3: claim committed; effect committed with matching C,H; successor committed

replay_rules: ensure_claim(C): atomic deterministic create. Success commits Q1. Existing path is acceptable only after exact readback matches C. Ambiguous/unavailable outcome authorizes nothing and returns recurring-open.

ensure_effect(C,H): atomic deterministic create at effect(C). Success commits Q2. Existing path is acceptable only after exact readback matches C and H. A mismatch fails closed; ambiguous/unavailable outcome authorizes neither successor nor completion.
ensure_successor(C,H): atomic deterministic create after Q2. Success commits Q3. Existing path is acceptable only after exact readback matches C and H.
state_model.safety_invariant: For a fixed C,H, at most one committed effect identity can exist because the effect destination is immutable and deterministic; replay never overwrites an existing mismatched record.
state_model.liveness_condition: Given later availability of the same bounded repository create/read transport, replay from Q1 or Q2 reaches Q3 without requiring richer execution, protected authority, user action, hosted compute, or finite credits. Ambiguous transport outcomes may delay progress but cannot create a second effect identity.

tested_traces.name: crash_before_effect
tested_traces.crash_point: after claim commit and before effect create

tested_traces.name: effect_then_crash_before_successor
tested_traces.crash_point: after effect commit and before successor create

falsification_controls: If effect(C) already exists with a different H, replay must fail closed and must not overwrite or emit successor.
If a create/read result is ambiguous or unavailable, that observation must not be converted into winner, absence, effect-success, or completion evidence.
If the external effect cannot itself be represented by an idempotency key plus independently verifiable immutable receipt, this mechanism is not proven for that effect class.
scope_statement: The three requested crash/restart traces converge duplicate-free for effects whose durable identity is the deterministic immutable role-local record effect(C) binding the same claim_id and payload hash. This does not establish exactly-once semantics for non-idempotent external side effects lacking a native idempotency key and independently readable receipt.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded exact-path role-local create/read transport; no hosted compute or quota-bearing execution
mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: role-local deterministic immutable idempotent effect records only

conflict_check: No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy or shared-ledger semantics were read or used. No scheduler mutation. One Phase-1 effect chain only.
exact_next_action: On the next valid invocation, test exactly one adversarial same-claim replay in which claim_id C is reused with a different effect_payload_hash H2 after an H1 effect already exists. Require fail-closed behavior with zero overwrite, zero successor emission for H2, preserved H1 reconstruction, and a nonempty recovery continuation without richer mode, finite quota, user execution or scheduler mutation.
